name: Message
description: Represents a secure, auditable message exchanged between a patient and a doctor.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning user (patient) of the conversation — set automatically on create from the authenticated patient; only the patient or an admin/doctor involved in the conversation may read or update messages.

attributes.name: senderId
attributes.description: The ID of the user (patient or doctor) who sent the message.

attributes.name: receiverId
attributes.description: The ID of the user (patient or doctor) who received the message.

attributes.name: conversationId
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the conversation thread.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The encrypted content of the message.

attributes.name: isRead
attributes.description: Indicates if the message has been read by the receiver.

attributes.name: isEncrypted
attributes.description: Indicates if the message content is encrypted.
